question: Should Crabbox accept this PR's skip-and-warn fallback for credential-bearing HTTP(S) Git remotes, or should the run fail closed instead?
rationale: Both choices protect the credential boundary, but they have different operator impact and the linked issue previously identified this as the core maintainer policy choice.

options.title: Accept skip-and-warn fallback
options.body: Merge the secure fallback behavior after proof shows the warning is redacted and file sync continues without forwarding the remote URL.

options.title: Fail closed instead
options.body: Ask for a smaller change that errors before sync when the origin contains HTTP(S) userinfo, trading progress for stronger operator visibility.

options.title: Defer for private seed credentials
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define a scoped private-repository seed credential mechanism that avoids argv and persisted remote config.

recommendation.title: Accept skip-and-warn fallback
recommendation.body: Merge the secure fallback behavior after proof shows the warning is redacted and file sync continues without forwarding the remote URL.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the strongest feature-history owner for git seed and the cross-platform sync paths touched by the policy choice.
